_readme: Stallion's gate invocations, declared ONCE. Each gate names the invocation text and the transports that must carry it; tools/gate-registry.mjs greps the real transport files for both directions of drift — a declared gate missing from a transport, and a transport carrying an invocation the registry does not declare (a shadow gate). Vendors: this is the stallion seed; add your own gates honestly. The transport set (the three git hooks, every workflow under .github/workflows as ci, package.json's `selftest` script as battery (one clean && chain), and every other package.json script as npm-alias) is TRANSPORTS in tools/gate-registry.mjs; a new transport kind is a graft recorded at vendor time, not a config edit.

gates.why: refuses code staged while no task is in flight — the earliest transport, one action from the mistake
the footer must name an in-flight task whose declared scope covers the staged code; CI's probe re-proves it refuses

every code commit in the push range carries an authorizing task record — the control clones cannot opt out of; the npm-alias transport is the package.json `task-coverage` alias, a bare runnable spelling of the same command
the push fence as the hook runs it: judges base..HEAD and refuses any pushed ref (git's stdin ref lines) outside HEAD's history — `git push origin other-branch` and `--all` no longer land unjudged
the gate for the gate: an unwired clone refuses to push until it is wired
the whole battery — every self-testing tool in tools/ — on every push
the census: every tracked source file seen by a declared gate
the dead-wiring sweep: contract members need producer and consumer
named prose claims re-proved against code evidence, bidirectionally
remote command strings must not expand where they are built
anti-bug-pinning over the real tools corpus
the overdue clock: an OPEN debt row past budget fails the build
a bare commit on a detached HEAD refuses loudly — at the commit it judges, not in the battery, where every detached checkout (pull_request CI, colocated jj) reddened it with no commit in sight

the vendoring lineage gate: in a vendored tree the committed VENDOR manifest is law — an undeclared, patched, or deleted vendored file and a missing mapped doc each refuse with a re-vendor remedy; upstream mode keeps stallion itself from ever carrying a forged manifest

the cross-task lessons index, derived from every committed register — the live run proves the registers still parse and the derivation still terminates over the real corpus; malformed registers refuse visibly, never silently
every registered guard proven to reach a newly-added file in its corpus
the task lifecycle state machine; the battery runs `task-state metrics` live, the npm alias spells it, and CI's lifecycle smokes drive it end to end
the eight-lane pass machinery; npm alias + CI's concurrent-record smokes
jj workspace drafting law; npm alias
the intervention gate (refuse at the act); npm alias

pins the capture seam's separator law against the COMMITTED artifact - the resolution recorded in a findings register must be true at the commit that carries it (the 0d1a9e3 landing gap: the working tree had the fix, the commit did not, and a working-tree pin re-run passed)
